parts.text: dance for fun

This recreational dance workshop provides participants with an opportunity to engage in accessible, beginner-friendly movement in a supportive, high-energy environment. The session includes a dynamic warm-up, step-by-step instruction in basic choreography, and interactive group dance exercises designed for stress relief and physical wellness. Participants will practice fundamental dance techniques set to upbeat music, focusing on rhythm, coordination, and creative expression without the pressure of formal performance. No prior dance experience is required.

The ACM Hackathon is a collaborative programming event where participants work in teams to ideate, design, and develop software or hardware projects from the ground up. Throughout the session, attendees engage in rapid software development, problem-solving, and technical skill-building across various domains such as web development, mobile applications, and artificial intelligence. Experienced mentors will be on hand to offer guidance and technical assistance. The event concludes with project demonstrations, allowing teams to present their completed functional prototypes to a panel of judges for evaluation and feedback.

Participants will engage in group jam sessions, practice musical improvisation, and share techniques across a variety of genres, such as indie, rock, and jazz.
